assumption_audit.mechanism: The Gruneisen parameter physically encodes the volume dependence of phonon frequencies; under hydrostatic compression the mode frequencies (hence Td) increase, so the Einstein spectral function must be evaluated at the pressure-shifted Td rather than the ambient one.
assumption_audit.parent_reduction: For small P_ext/B0 the shifted argument Td*(1 - gamma_gruneisen*P_ext/B0) reduces to Td to leading order, recovering the parent pressure term; the change is a within-law refinement of how pressure enters the vibrational energy scale.
